title: Message Pop
blurb: A short rising pop — the universal shape of a new-message notification. It's not any one app's sound, which is exactly what makes it useful: it reads as 'you got a message' without borrowing anyone's trademark chime. Editors drop it over on-screen texts, streamers use it for chat alerts, and pranksters play it near people mid-conversation to watch the reflexive phone check.
origin: Original synthesis in the style of generic messaging-app pops.
